bullets: Added a clearer update-required message for legacy Desktop clients, telling users their app version needs updating instead of reporting the model as unavailable.
Raised the Freebuff Desktop idle timeout from 10 to 15 minutes of inactivity before the system reclaims the hosted session.
Added a purchases-paused notice for Desktop multi-session paths so up-to-date clients needing a fresh purchase are refused without being charged.
Replaced the Freebuff Pro house ad copy with a new after-hours hero image and shorter text explaining the value of upgrading to a paid subscription.
Updated the CLI sponsored-run containment for linked git worktrees on Linux to mount the real .git common dir as a tmpfs with entries rebound read-only.
